name: Crab Classic Imitation Crab Leg Style
ingredientsText: Alaska pollock (msc certified), water, egg whites, corn starch, sugar, sorbitol, contains 2% or less of: king crab meat, natural and artificial flavor (extracts of blue crab, snow crab, lobster, and alaska pollock), refined fish oil* (anchovy, sardine), rice wine (water, rice, koji), modified tapioca starch, sea salt, carrageenan, yam flour, potassium chloride, disodium inosinate, sodium pyrophosphate, soy lecithin, carmine, paprika, color added.
notes: Imitation crab is pollock (fish) but also lists king crab meat and crab/lobster extracts, so shellfish is contains.
